narr: Several hours of heavy rainfall impacted central Kansas with upwards of 12 inches reported in Lincon County. Several reports of flooding were relayed from Lincoln, Ellsworth, and Saline counties.
ev: Water was reported over 29th Road about three miles north of Highway 40.
Highway 18 just east of Beverly is closed due to water over the road.
Northeast Main Street is closed in Ellsworth due to water over the road.
Widespread flooding in around the Brookville area, including roads and the city park.
